description: İstanbul Enerji A.Ş.: electricity datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality open data portal, a city open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by İstanbul Enerji A.Ş.. Coverage: İstanbul Enerji A.Ş.. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about electricity; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: İstanbul Güneş Enerji Santralleri Üretim Miktarları; İkitelli Güneş Enerjisi Santrali Elektrik Üretim Miktarları; IMM Facilities Electrical Energy Production Amounts. Formats seen: XLSX. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality Open Data License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-ibb-gov-tr.
